motivation: Compare a second already-cached multilingual foundation model on the exact assertion-query development diagnostic. Qwen3.5-9B previously failed the project's binary screen; this experiment does not erase that result or presume that a larger model is better.
asset_binding: Verify every file against the existing public qwen-control-87/model-manifest.json. Use the unadapted base, float32 nonquantized arithmetic as in the prior pinned Qwen control, and original vocabulary projection.
population_and_prompts: Identical 256 balanced exposed development cases and both predeclared assertion prompts from experiment22. Four single-token letters, no generation sampling, parameter updates, threshold fitting or regression inputs.
interpretation: Compare per-language and per-assertion accuracy to the Gemma diagnostic. This is architecture exploration on development, never independent qualification. Conditional answer probabilities are uncalibrated.
